review_text: Visited Glen’s Simplify Café with the hope of finding a good café, and ended up loving the place so much that it’s now on my must-visit list whenever I’m in Bangalore.  We tried quite a few items — coffee (both hot and cold, milk-based and black), chicken cream soup (which we absolutely loved), tandoori chicken croissant, veg patties, charcoal pizza, chocolate tart… and the list goes on. Guilty of eating way too much, but honestly couldn’t help it because everything was so good!  Hospitality: 9/10 Food: 8/10 Ambience: 10/10 Cleanliness: 9/10  From the moment we entered until the time we left, we truly enjoyed the experience. review_text: Had a lovely breakfast outing at Glen’s Bakehouse, HSR, and it was nothing short of delightful. We started with the Combo Breakfast with Chicken Sausage, and every element on the plate was perfectly done. The scrambled eggs with butter were soft, creamy, and comforting, pairing beautifully with the juicy chicken sausages. The toasted multigrain bread added a wholesome crunch, made even better with a generous touch of butter. Ending the platter with a slice of apple cake was a sweet surprise, moist, lightly spiced, and absolutely satisfying along with a soothing cup of English Breakfast tea to round it off.  The chicken puff was flaky on the outside and packed with flavorful, well seasoned chicken inside warm, crisp, and irresistible. To refresh the palate, the fresh lime water (mixed) was perfectly balanced, light, and revitalizing.  The highlight for me was the Spicy Citrus Chicken Steak tender, succulent chicken infused with zesty citrus notes and a gentle spice kick that lingered beautifully with every bite.  Overall, a wholesome, comforting, and flavour packed experience. Glen’s Bakehouse never fails to impress with its quality, taste, and warm café vibes. Definitely a place I’d love to revisit! 😋🍽️

address: 2337, SECTOR 1, HSR Layout 17th Cross, 24th Main Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102
review_text: This is highly unprofessional and unacceptable behavior. For the second time, we are facing the same problem with your staff. They are quick to bill every single item, but when it comes to packing, items are repeatedly missing. This is not a one-off mistake—it has happened twice now.  The first time, a cake was missing. Only after reaching home we realized it, and when we called, the response was that they needed to "check the stock" before crediting the amount. Fine, we accepted it.  But today it happened again. I specifically reminded the billing person about the previous issue and asked him to ensure everything was packed correctly. He assured me it would be taken care of—but yet again, an item was missing.  This is not just carelessness; it borders on deliberate malpractice. Customers are forced to pay upfront, carry the order home, and then waste time double-checking and calling back for missing items. This feels less like a mistake and more like a systematic way of making money.  Does the owner even know what is happening here, or ?  On top of that, last time when the refund was given, you conveniently skipped the GST amount. You charged GST initially, but when crediting back via GPay, only the item cost was refunded, not the tax. This is nothing short of an unethical practice.  Such repeated lapses raise serious doubts about the integrity and honesty of your establishment.  I called at 19:24 and was told I would get a call back in 10 minutes. I waited patiently for 20 minutes, and when I called again, I was informed that they needed to “investigate thoroughly” before taking any action. This kind of response is completely unacceptable and deeply disappointing.  Let them investigate, of course; that’s necessary—but how long does it really take?  It clearly shows that customer complaints are not a priority for them. The attitude seems to be: once the product is sold, the customer doesn’t matter anymore—simple mantra: it is like GET LOST.  At around 19:54, they transferred the money, including GST. It seems the investigation has been completed, but the real question is—what measures are they going to implement to ensure this mistake does not keep happening?. Or Just say sorry (how many times??).  It feels as though they assume that people who come to Glen’s are all ‘posh’ and therefore won’t bother or care if an item is missing. But the reality is different—whether someone is posh or not, it is still their hard-earned money, and no one will quietly accept being taken for a ride. Anyone, regardless of background, has the right to question and demand accountability.

Overall, my experience here was disappointing, and I would think twice before visiting again.

review_text: The quality of the food at this place is truly exceptional, making it a must-visit spot for any food lover. I make it a point to visit here regularly, ensuring that I carve out time from my schedule every 15 days to indulge in the delicious offerings they have. This place has become one of my absolute favorites, and I always look forward to returning.  Among the many dishes I enjoy, the veg lasagna and the peri peri paneer stand out as my personal favorites. The flavors are rich and satisfying, making every bite a delight. To complement these savory dishes, I usually order a hazelnut coffee, which is nothing short of amazing. The balance of the coffee’s robust flavor with the nutty sweetness of hazelnut is perfect, making it the ideal beverage to accompany my meal.  Of course, no visit here is complete without indulging in their cupcakes. They are simply mandatory, a treat I can never pass up. The soft, moist texture and rich frosting make them an absolute must-try.  For those looking for other recommendations, the croissant with hot coffee is a delightful combination, perfect for a lighter snack. And if you’re in the mood for something heartier, the pizza here is another excellent choice. However, it’s worth noting that the preparation time can sometimes be quite long, which might be a bit frustrating, especially if you’re in a hurry. Despite this, the overall experience is still well worth it.  In conclusion, this place is a gem that I highly recommend to anyone. Whether you’re there for the veg lasagna, peri peri paneer, hazelnut coffee, or cupcakes, you’re in for a treat. Just be prepared for a bit of a wait at times, but trust me, it’s worth it.

review_text: Glen’s Bakehouse: Sweet Treats and Savory Bites in Bangalore  I recently had a delightful dining experience at Glen’s Bakehouse in HSR Layout, Bangalore. This bakery cafe offers a perfect ambiance for both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a delicious meal.  The food was simply amazing! Reservations are recommended to avoid a wait.  They also offer a tempting English breakfast and weekend brunch options, which I’m definitely planning to try on my next visit.  The extensive menu caters to a variety of tastes, offering everything from sweet treats to savory dishes. It’s a perfect place to hang out with friends or unwind after a long day.  Overall, Glen’s Bakehouse is a great choice for anyone looking for a delicious and satisfying meal in a charming atmosphere.  Pocket Pinch: ₹500 per person
